course_name_original: Selected Items of Strenght of Materials
course_name_en: Selected Items of Strength of Materials
syllabus_topics: Variational principles in elasticity and strength: Force and deformation variant of the solution of bar systems
The principle of virtual displacements and virtual forces
The principle of the minimum of total potential energy and the principle of the minimum of complementary energy
Approximate solutions of bar systems and beams
Theory of bending of thin plates of general shape: Equilibrium equations (definition of internal force effects)
An example solved both in vector and scalar
Anisotropic materials, composites: History of composite materials, technology of production of composite materials
Classical lamination theory, composites with random reinforcement
Sandwiches, thin-walled composite pressure vessels - cylinder
Sphere, various shapes (hemispherical, ellipsoid, geodetic isotenzoid)
Statistics in theories of strength and fatigue: Statistical methods of data evaluation
Construction and materials - inspiration by nature, myths and reality about composites, fatigue of composites
bibliography: Lecturers's slides and other resources are placed in http://moodle-vyuka.cvut.cz
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
